verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Amazon Chime SDK adds real-time audio, video and screen sharing to "web or mobile applications." The official JS SDK repo documents creating a meeting session in the client. However, the pack never names dedicated iOS or Android SDKs, nor shows that they share the same session and track model with one backend. Missing for 10: explicit official iOS and Android SDK evidence, documentation of a consistent session/track model across platforms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a single backend serving all clients.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: add messaging, audio, video, and screen sharing capabilities to your web or mobile applications
Create a meeting session in your client application.
Each attendee can publish one video source, up to a total of 25 simultaneous videos per meeting.
